Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "C) sugar dissolving in water" as a chemical change due to a misunderstanding of the chemistry concepts involved. Dissolving sugar in water is a physical change because no new substance is formed; the sugar molecules remain intact and can be recovered by evaporating the water. The Planner failed to recognize that "B) a garbage can rusting" is the correct answer, as rusting involves a chemical reaction (oxidation) that results in the formation of a new substance (iron oxide).
